blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Ambiguous inputs can admit multiple interpretations, each potentially yielding a different answer. Existing work largely treats this ambiguity as a property of the input, yet for a particular language model, only some alternatives may be known and answerable. We therefore distinguish world ambiguity, capturing all alternatives admitted by an input, from model ambiguity, capturing those accessible to the responding model. To characterize these alternatives, we formalize natural-language clarifications through three desiderata: \emph{uniqueness}, \emph{faithfulness}, and \emph{answer equivalence}. We show that these desiderata induce a one-to-one correspondence between valid answers and equivalence classes of clarifications, implying that any interpretation can be represented either by its answer or by the clarifications that uniquely express it. We leverage this correspondence to introduce \circleclar{}, a black-box method that estimates the set of answers available to a model by checking consistency along an answer--clarification--answer cycle. Across open-domain QA and executable Text-to-SQL, \circleclar{} achieves strong recovery of these answer sets. In QA, the recovered support yields the strongest overall performance in model-dependent ambiguity detection and enables effective selection among answering, clarifying, and abstaining. Together, these results demonstrate the practical value of a model-dependent view of ambiguity and its characterization through an answer-clarification correspondence.
blocks.zh: 含糊不清的投入可以接受多种解释,每一种都可能产生不同的答案。 现有工作基本上将这种模糊性视为输入的属性,然而对于某一语言模型来说,可能只有一些替代办法可以知道和回答。 因此,我们把世界的模糊性区分开来,把投入所接受的所有替代物与模型的模糊性区分开来,把反应模型所了解的替代物区分开来。 为了描述这些替代品,我们将自然语言的澄清正式化,通过三个desiderata:\emph{unique}、\emph{finity}和\emph{answerquality}。 我们表明,这些 " desiderata " 导致有效答复与等同澄清之间的一对一对应,意味着任何解释都可以通过其答复或独特的说明加以体现。 我们利用这些函文引入\circleclar{},一种黑盒方法,通过在答案-澄清-答案周期中检查一致性来估计模型可用的一组答案. 横跨开放域的QA和可执行的文本对SQL,\circleclar{} 实现这些答案集的强烈恢复. 在质量保证中,恢复的支持在模型依赖的模糊度检测中产生最强的整体性能,并能在回答、澄清和弃权中进行有效的选择。 这些结果共同显示了以模型为依据的模糊性观点及其通过解答-澄清函证的定性的实际价值。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Ambiguous inputs can admit multiple reasonable interpretations, each potentially leading to a different answer. Existing work has largely treated this ambiguity as a property of the input itself [ 12 , 14 , 4 , 5 , 11 , 6 , 16 ] . However, when an ambiguous input is presented to a Large Language Model, not every valid interpretation is necessarily accessible and answerable by that model. Consider, for example, the question “Who voiced the snake in the Jungle Book?” . The intended adaptation is unspecified: for the 1967 film, the answer is Sterling Holloway, whereas for the 2016 film, it is Scarlett Johansson. While both interpretations are valid, one model may know both films and their answers, whereas another may know only one. The ambiguity inherent in the question remains unchanged; what changes is how much of that ambiguity is accessible to the responding model .
blocks.zh: 含糊不清的投入可以接受多种合理的解释,每一种解释都可能导致不同的答案。 现有工作基本上将这种模糊性视为投入本身的财产[12、14、4、5、11、6、16]。 但是,当向大语言模型提供模棱两可的投入时,并非每一种有效的解释都必然能够被该模型所利用和回答。 例如,考虑“谁在丛林之书中表达了蛇?” 。 。 。 。 意向改编没有说明:对于1967年电影,答案是斯特林·霍洛威,而对于2016年电影,答案是斯嘉丽·约翰松. 虽然两种解释都有效,但一种模式可能既知道电影,又知道答案,而另一种模式可能只知道一种。 问题的内在模糊性没有改变;对此,应答的模型究竟有多少模糊性。

blocks.en: We therefore propose to distinguish between world ambiguity and model ambiguity ( Figure 1 ). World ambiguity captures the alternatives admitted by the input, independent of any particular model. Model ambiguity instead captures those alternatives that are known and answerable to the responding model. The distinction is consequential: two models can face the same world ambiguity but, because they know different parts of its ambiguity, effectively face different problems. A model that knows several valid alternatives should recognize that committing to one leaves the user’s intent unresolved; a model that knows only one alternative, or none, is in a fundamentally different situation. We therefore ask how to estimate the interpretations and corresponding answers a particular model knows .
blocks.zh: 因此,我们建议区分世界模糊性和模型模糊性(图1)。 世界模糊性捕捉了输入所接受的替代品,独立于任何特定的模型. 相反,模型模棱两可地捕捉到已知并对响应模型负责的替代品。 区别是必然的:两种模式可以面对同一个世界的模糊性,但由于它们知道其模糊性的不同部分,所以有效地面对不同的问题. 一个知道若干有效备选方案的模式应该承认,承诺一个模式会使用户的意图得不到解决;一个只知道一种或没有一种备选方案的模式处于根本不同的境地。 因此,我们询问如何估计一个特定模型所知道的解释和相应的答案。

blocks.en: To do so, we use natural-language clarifications [ 12 , 6 ] , which are explicit representations of distinct interpretations of the original input. While such clarifications are widely used in prior work, their precise definition is often omitted [ 5 , 21 , 13 ] . Hence, we propose to characterize valid clarifications through three desiderata: (i) uniqueness : a clarification should admit only a single answer; (ii) faithfulness : that answer must also be a valid answer for the original question; and (iii) answer equivalence : clarifications that induce the same answer should be treated as equivalent. Our key observation is that, under these desiderata, each valid answer corresponds to exactly one clarification class, thereby providing two complementary representations of the same interpretation ( Figure 1 b).
blocks.zh: 为此,我们使用自然语言的澄清[12,6],这些澄清明确表达了对原始投入的不同解释。 虽然这些澄清在先前的工作中被广泛使用,但其确切定义往往被省略[5、21、13]。 因此,我们提议通过三个定义来描述有效的澄清:(一) 独一性:澄清只应接受一个答案;(二) 忠诚性:该答案也必须是对最初问题的有效答案;(三) 答案等同性:引起相同答案的澄清应作为等同性对待。 我们的主要看法是,在这些定义下,每个有效答案都完全对应一个澄清类别,从而提供了同一解释的两个补充说明(图1b)。

blocks.en: This correspondence suggests a simple way to estimate what ambiguity a model can realize. If a model proposes an answer, expresses the corresponding interpretation through a clarification, and then reliably returns to the same answer under that clarification, the resulting cycle provides additional evidence that this alternative is accessible to the model. We turn this idea into CircleClar , a black-box method for estimating the model-specific set of realizable answers ( Figure 1 c). We evaluate CircleClar on open-domain QA using AmbigQA [ 12 ] and our curated high-quality version (AmbigQA-HQ), and on executable Text-to-SQL using AMBROSIA [ 14 ] . CircleClar achieves the best answer-set F1 in seven of twelve model–dataset settings and outperforms direct-generation baselines across all QA settings. Moreover, its cardinality can predict model-dependent ambiguity and serves as an effective basis for deciding whether to answer, clarify, or abstain. Taken together, these results support a model-dependent view of ambiguity: what matters for a particular LLM is not only which alternatives an input admits, but which of them the model can realize.
blocks.zh: 这种函证建议了一个简单的方法来估计一个模型能够意识到什么模糊性. 如果一个模型提出一个答案,通过澄清表达相应的解释,然后根据该澄清可靠地返回同一答案,那么由此产生的周期会提供更多证据,证明该替代方法可供模型使用。 我们把这个想法变成 CircleClar,一种用于估计模型特定可实现的一组答案的黑盒方法(图1c). 我们使用 AmbigQA [12] 和 我们的高品质版本( AmbigQA- HQ) 来评价 CircleClar, 并使用 AMBROSIA [14] 来评价可执行文本到 SQL 。 圆形 Clar在12个模型中的7个模型——数据集设置中实现了最好的答案集F1,并且超越了所有QA设置的直接生成基线. 此外,其核心地位可以预测依赖模型的模糊性,并成为决定是回答、澄清还是弃权的有效基础。 总而言之,这些结果支持了一种依赖模型的模棱两可的观点:对于某一特定的LLM而言,重要的是,不仅某一投入能够承认哪些替代物,而且模型能够认识到其中哪些。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
A common way to study input ambiguity is to make the possible interpretations of an underspecified input explicit.
In open-domain QA, interpretations can be expressed through disambiguated questions, either provided as annotations [ 12 ] or generated recursively as part of answering ambiguous questions [ 6 ] .
In semantic parsing, where natural-language inputs are mapped to executable representations, such as SQL queries or tool calls, different interpretations can be expressed as distinct executable programs [ 2 , 14 ] , or first stated in natural language before being mapped to logical forms [ 15 ] . Related work also makes alternative readings explicit as structured interpretation–answer pairs [ 16 ] , while Tomov et al. [20] take a distributional view, representing ambiguity through a ground-truth distribution over semantic answer classes and their relative likelihoods.
Beyond such explicit representations, Kirchhof et al. [8] takes a more general view of underspecification, describing it as uncertainty about the intended task or as missing contextual information, modeled via a latent variable model.
blocks.zh:
研究输入模糊性的一个共同方法是,明确对未明确输入的可能解释。
在开放域QA中,解释可以通过混淆不清的问题表达,或者作为说明[12]提供,或者作为回答模棱两可问题的一部分递归生成. [6].
在语义解析中,当自然语言输入被映射到可执行的表示,例如SQL查询或工具调用时,不同的解释可以表现为不同的可执行程序[2,14],或者首先用自然语言来表示,然后被映射到逻辑形式[15]. 相關的工作也使可替代的读取明确为结构化解释-答对 [16],而Tomov等. [20]采取分布式观点,通过对语义解答类及其相对可能性的地真分布来表示模糊.
除了这种明确陈述之外,Kirchhof等人也提出了意见。 [8] 更笼统地看待规格不足问题,将其描述为对预期任务的不确定性,或通过潜在可变模型模拟的缺失背景信息。

blocks.en:
Recent work treats input ambiguity as a quantity that can be estimated from model outputs.
ICE [ 5 ] treats it as a source of aleatoric uncertainty. It generates multiple clarifications of the input, obtains predictions for each, and ensembles them to separate aleatoric uncertainty from epistemic uncertainty.
Spectral Uncertainty [ 21 ] extends this approach by doing soft clustering via embeddings.
CLARA [ 13 ] generates multiple clarifications and uses their semantic diversity as an ambiguity signal, while Shi et al. [17] detect ambiguity from sampled-answer distributions.
CLUES [ 25 ] instead uses a two-stage process from interpretations to answers, separating uncertainty across interpretations from instability in their associated answers.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作将输入模糊视为可以从模型产出中估计的数量。
ICE [5] 视之为取食不确定性之源. 它能产生对输入的多处澄清,获得对每个输入的预测,并把它们合为一体,以区分心动不确定性和感知不确定性.
光谱不确定性[21]通过嵌入来进行软集群来扩展这一方法.
CLARA [13] 生成多种澄清,并用其语义多样性作为模糊信号,而Shi等. [17] 从抽样答案分布中检测出模糊.
CLUES[25]转而采用从解释到答案的两阶段过程,将解释中的不确定性与相关答案中的不稳定性区分开来.

blocks.en:
Beyond estimating ambiguity itself, other work incorporates ambiguity detection or recognition into clarification systems, benchmarks, and policies. Lee et al. [10] formulate open-domain QA as a pipeline that detects ambiguous questions, presents candidate interpretations in a clarification question, and answers based on the user’s response.
CLAM [ 9 ] similarly classifies whether a question is ambiguous and selectively requests clarification before answering.
CLAMBER [ 24 ] jointly benchmarks the identification of ambiguous information needs and the generation of clarification questions.
INTENT-SIM [ 22 ] estimates entropy over simulated user intents to determine when clarification is beneficial.
ACT [ 3 ] learns multi-turn clarification policies and evaluates implicit ambiguity recognition through models’ clarify-or-answer decisions.
Zhang, Knox, and Choi [ 23 ] use simulated future conversation turns to train clarify-or-answer behavior and evaluate the resulting decisions against ambiguity labels.
Su and Cardie [ 18 ] further show that ambiguity recognition capability does not necessarily translate into clarification behavior: models often identify an input as ambiguous when asked explicitly, yet default to answering in ordinary QA.
Closely related to our work, BAG [ 1 ] uses sampled responses as a belief state to guide whether to answer, clarify, or abstain. Its BAG3 variant groups responses by meaning and proposes interpretations for each group to distinguish alternative readings from factual inconsistencies.
blocks.zh:
除了估计模糊性本身外,其他工作还将模糊性探测或识别纳入澄清系统、基准和政策。 李等编. [10] 制定开放式域名QA,作为发现模棱两可问题的管道,在澄清问题中提出候选解释,并根据用户的答复做出答案.
CLAM [9]同样将一个问题是否含糊不清,有选择地要求在回答之前加以澄清.
CLAMBER [24] 联合基准确定模糊的信息需要并产生澄清问题。
INTENT-SIM [22] 在模拟用户的意向上估算Entropy,以确定澄清何时有益.
ACT[3] 学习多回合澄清政策,通过模型的澄清或回答决定评价隐含的模糊性识别.
张作霖,诺克克,和崔作 [23] 使用模拟后期对话转会来训练澄清或回答行为,并评价由此产生的决定与模糊标签相对.
Su and Cardie [18]进一步表明模糊识别能力并不一定会转化为澄清行为:模型在明确询问时往往将输入识别为模糊,而默认在普通的QA中回答.
与我们的工作密切相关的是,BAG [1]将抽样答复作为信仰状态来指导是回答,澄清还是弃权. 其BAG3变体按含义对答复进行分组,并针对每个组提出解释,以区分替代读法与事实不一致.

blocks.en:
Overall, prior work studied how ambiguity can be represented, estimated, and handled through clarifications. Far less attention has been paid to how ambiguity varies with the responding model’s own knowledge. APA [ 7 ] recognizes this, defining perceived ambiguity as a property of a particular model and measuring it through the reduction in the model’s average token entropy from the original question to a self-disambiguated version.
While conceptually sharing this perspective, our work goes further by formally distinguishing the two different types of ambiguity and defining not only a quantitative estimator but also actionable estimates of clarifications and their answers.
blocks.zh:
总的来说,先前的工作研究了如何通过澄清来体现、估计和处理模糊性。 对响应模式本身知识的模糊性如何不同没有给予多少关注。 APA [7] 承认这一点,将所认为的模糊定义为特定模型的一个属性,并通过将模型的平均符号 en从最初的问题减少到自相矛盾的版本来测量.
我们在概念上赞同这一看法,但我们的工作更进一步,正式区分了两种不同的模糊性,不仅界定了量化估计,而且还界定了对澄清及其答案的可采取行动的估计。

blocks.en: 3 Why Input Ambiguity Should be Model Dependent
blocks.zh: 3 为什么输入含糊不清 应该是模型依赖

blocks.en: Ambiguity is typically treated as a property of the input: a question is ambiguous when it admits multiple valid interpretations. As such, most prior work [ 12 , 4 , 11 , 6 , 5 , 14 ] studies ambiguity independently of the used model. Similar to Kim et al. [7] , we propose to treat ambiguity as dependent on model knowledge and, therefore, as a model-dependent property . We formalize this distinction below and empirically show that it varies substantially across models ( Figure 2 ), motivating our model-dependent framework for characterizing ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 模糊性通常被视为输入属性:一个问题在承认多种有效解释时是模糊不清的. 因此,大多数先前的工作[12、4、11、6、5、14]都独立于所使用的模型来研究模糊性。 与金等相类. [7],我们建议将模糊性视为取决于模型知识,因此也视为一个依赖于模型的财产。 我们将在下文中正式确定这种区别,并按经验显示,这种区别在不同的模型中差别很大(图2),这促使我们建立以模型为基础的框架来描述模糊性。

Crucially, however, world ambiguity need not coincide with the ambiguity realized by a particular model.
Returning to our example, a model that knows both Jungle Book films can realize that the question admits at least two interpretations and associate each with its corresponding answer. In contrast, another model may only know the 2016 film—due, for instance, to differences in training data, capacity, distillation, or compression—and therefore realize only Scarlett Johansson as a valid answer.
The underlying question is equally ambiguous in both cases: its world answer support 𝒲 T ​ ( x ) \mathcal{W}_{T}(x) has not changed.
What changes is which parts of this ambiguity are accessible to the model. To capture this distinction, for a model p T p_{T} we define its model-realizable answer support as ℳ T ( x ) := supp p T ( ⋅ ∣ x ) ∩ 𝒲 T ( x ) = { y ∈ 𝒲 T ( x ) : p T ( y ∣ x ) > 0 } . \mathcal{M}_{T}(x):=\operatorname{supp}p_{T}(\cdot\mid x)\cap\mathcal{W}_{T}(x)=\{y\in\mathcal{W}_{T}(x):p_{T}(y\mid x)>0\}.

This distinction between these two forms of ambiguity matters because, when deciding how a particular model should respond, world ambiguity alone is insufficient.
Suppose | 𝒲 T ​ ( x ) | > 1 |\mathcal{W}_{T}(x)|>1 , but a model realizes only one of these answers. From an oracle perspective, the question is ambiguous. From the model’s perspective, there is no alternative interpretation on which it can meaningfully act. Conversely, a model that realizes several valid answers should recognize that answering with any single one implicitly commits to a specific interpretation.
Thus, the appropriate response—whether to answer, clarify, or abstain—depends not only on which answers exist, but on which of them are realizable by the model.
Our goal is therefore not to recover 𝒲 T ​ ( x ) \mathcal{W}_{T}(x) , but to estimate the model-specific set ℳ T ​ ( x ) \mathcal{M}_{T}(x) .

blocks.en: 4 A Clarification Framework for Estimating Model-Dependent Ambiguity
blocks.zh: 4 估算模型-依赖性不确定性的澄清框架

blocks.en:
We now turn to the question of how to estimate the model-realizable answer support ℳ T ​ ( x ) \mathcal{M}_{T}(x) . To do so, we use clarifications, which provide a natural way to express interpretations as natural-language inputs for the model.
While clarifications have been previously used [ 12 , 6 , 5 , 13 ] , a precise formal characterization of what constitutes a valid clarification has, to our knowledge, not been provided. This absence is consequential: without a rigorous definition, clarifications may possess undesirable properties that introduce confounds into downstream estimators. To address this gap, we are the first to formally characterize valid clarifications through a set of explicit desiderata ( Section 4.1 ). Crucially, we prove that, under these desiderata, the set of clarifications admits an equivalent representation of the answer space. We then exploit this equivalence to construct CircleClar , a black-box estimator of ℳ T ​ ( x ) \mathcal{M}_{T}(x) .

我们现在来谈谈如何估计模式可实现的答案支持M T (x)\mathcal{M}_{T} (x)的问题。 为此,我们使用了澄清,这为解释提供了一种自然方式,作为模型的自然语言投入。
虽然以前曾用过[12.、6.、5.、13]澄清,但据我们所知,并未对构成有效澄清的内容作出准确的正式说明。 造成这种情况的原因是:如果没有严格的定义,澄清就可能具有不可取的特性,给下游估计器带来混乱。 为了弥补这一差距,我们首先通过一套明确的 " 澄清 " (第4.1节)正式说明有效的澄清。 关键的是,我们证明,在这些 " 解说 " 下,这套澄清承认了对答案空间的同等表述。 然后,我们利用这种等同性来构建 CircleClar,一个M T (x)\ mathcal{M}_{T} (x)的黑箱估计器。

blocks.en: We begin with the most basic requirement: a clarification must actually resolve the ambiguity. Consider again the ambiguous question “Who voiced the snake in The Jungle Book?” in which the adaptation is unspecified. A logical clarification would be “Who voiced the snake in the 1967 animated film The Jungle Book?” . This reformulation resolves the ambiguity by selecting a single interpretation and, consequently, a particular answer. This motivates our first desideratum.

blocks.en:
Our primary evaluation asks how accurately CircleClar recovers the model-realizable answer support.
We then evaluate two downstream uses of the recovered support in QA: using its cardinality to detect model-dependent ambiguity and deriving the response action from the estimated support.

blocks.en: We evaluate CircleClar across two domains. For open-domain question answering, we use 1,000 ambiguous questions from AmbigQA [ 12 ] , together with AmbigQA-HQ, a manually curated set of 100 questions derived primarily from AmbigQA with more complete and reliable rewrite–answer annotations (see Appendix B ). For executable Text-to-SQL, we evaluate on 96 ambiguous requests from AMBROSIA [ 14 ] . Since we treat final answers y y by their task-relevant semantic meaning rather than as raw strings, we construct the corresponding equivalence classes using an LLM-based semantic grouping procedure tailored to the task (Appendix E ).

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.1 限制

blocks.en: CircleClar is a precision-oriented estimator whose recall is limited by the initial candidate set: interpretations that the model can answer when explicitly specified may still be unlikely to arise during candidate generation and therefore remain undiscovered. Relatedly, we focus on the support of model-realizable answers rather than the relative likelihood of interpretations, treating recovered alternatives equally through a set representation and its cardinality. Further, successful recovery through an answer–clarification–answer cycle provides evidence of model realizability but does not guarantee correctness, as a model may consistently reproduce a factual error; under black-box access, such confidently held errors are generally difficult to distinguish from correct knowledge. Similarly, under our desiderata, clarifications are defined by their answers, and, as such, a valid clarification could theoretically have an unrelated meaning. However, in practice, as we create the clarifications based on their answers and the question, this does not happen. Our evaluation is also limited by the quality and coverage of ambiguity annotations, which may omit valid interpretations or introduce unsupported ones. We mitigate this by constructing the curated AmbigQA-HQ benchmark (Appendix B ), but cannot guarantee complete coverage. Finally, ℳ T ​ ( x ) \mathcal{M}_{T}(x) captures answerable model-dependent ambiguity and does not include interpretations that a model can recognize but cannot answer, nor purely linguistic ambiguity it may detect without resolving. Explicitly separating interpretation recognition from answerability is an interesting direction for future work.
blocks.zh: CircleClar是一个精准导向的估算器,其召回受到最初的候选集的限制:模型在明确规定时能够解答的解释在候选组中仍然不太可能出现,因此仍然不被发现. 与此相关的是,我们侧重于支持模式可实现的答案,而不是解释的相对可能性,通过一套代表性及其基本性,平等对待已恢复的替代办法。 此外,通过一个解答-澄清-解答周期成功取回提供了模型可实现性的证据,但并不保证正确性,因为模型可能不断重复一个事实错误;在黑箱访问中,这种自信持有的错误通常难以与正确的知识区分开来。 同样,根据我们的 " desiderata " ,澄清由它们的答复来界定,因此,有效的澄清在理论上可能具有无关的意义。 然而,实际上,在我们根据他们的答复和问题作出澄清时,情况并非如此。 我们的评价也受到模棱两可说明的质量和覆盖面的限制,因为模棱两可的说明可能省略了有效的解释或引入了没有支持的解释。 我们通过制定阿姆比加-HQ基准(附录B)来缓解这种情况,但不能保证完全覆盖。 最后,M T (x)\mathcal{M}_{T}(x)抓住了可回答的模型依赖的模糊性,并不包括一个模型能够识别但不能回答的解释,也不包括纯粹语言上的模糊性,它可能在不解决的情况下检测出. 明确区分解释识别和可回答性是未来工作的一个令人感兴趣的方向。

blocks.en: 6.2 A Model-Dependent View of Ambiguity
blocks.zh: 6.2 模糊性模型-依赖性视图

blocks.en: Our results support a view of ambiguity that distinguishes what an input permits from what a particular model can realize. While the world may admit many valid interpretations, only a subset may be accessible within a model’s knowledge, and it is this model-realizable ambiguity that determines the alternatives on which the model can meaningfully act. This distinction complements the conventional, world-centric view of ambiguity and provides a more model-specific account of how underspecified inputs are represented and handled. Our clarification framework provides a natural way to characterize this object by establishing a one-to-one correspondence between valid answers and equivalence classes of clarifications. CircleClar is one concrete way of exploiting this correspondence under black-box access, but the underlying perspective is more general. We hope this view provides a useful basis for future work on ambiguity-aware language models and their interaction with users.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果支持一种模棱两可的观点,这种观点将投入允许什么和某一特定模式能够实现什么区分开来。 虽然世界可能接受许多有效的解释,但只有子集才能在模型的知识中访问到,而模型能够有意义地采取行动的替代办法正是这种模型可实现的模糊性。 这一区别补充了以世界为中心的传统模糊性观点,并更具体地说明了如何反映和处理未充分说明的投入。 我们的澄清框架通过在有效答复和等同的澄清类别之间建立一对一的对应关系,为确定这一目的的特征提供了自然的方法。 圆形 克莱尔是在黑匣子访问下利用这种通信的一种具体方式,但背后的观点更为笼统. 我们希望这种观点为今后关于认识模糊的语言模式及其与用户互动的工作提供有益的基础。

blocks.en: Appendix B Construction of AmbigQA-HQ
blocks.zh: 附录B 建造AmbigQA-HQ

blocks.en: Our evaluation requires a reliable and sufficiently complete reference set of valid answers for each ambiguous question. AmbigQA’s disambiguated rewrites and answers [ 12 ] provide a natural empirical reference for 𝒲 T ​ ( x ) \mathcal{W}_{T}(x) , from which we construct each model-specific ℳ T ​ ( x ) \mathcal{M}_{T}(x) . However, the original annotations do not always meet this requirement. Some questions labeled ambiguous support only one answer under their original wording; their additional answers are obtained only by changing the question. For genuinely ambiguous questions, valid readings may be missing, a rewrite may remain unresolved or introduce an unsupported reading, several rewrites may yield the same answer, or an answer may be factually incorrect. These errors change both the membership and the size of the reference answer set. We therefore construct AmbigQA-HQ primarily by selecting genuinely ambiguous questions from AmbigQA and then verifying, repairing, and completing their disambiguated rewrites and answers. Of the 100 questions, 96 were selected from AmbigQA and four were newly constructed to cover additional ambiguity patterns; their answers were verified against authoritative sources.

Return only the requested JSON object , with no Markdown or additional text . USER : Choose exactly one action for the user ’ s question : ANSWER , CLARIFY , or ABSTAIN . Base your decision only on the question and your own current knowledge . Use the following criteria : - ANSWER if you can reliably provide exactly one distinct answer . Choose ANSWER even if the question has other plausible readings , as long as you cannot reliably provide a different answer for any of them . - CLARIFY if at least two plausible readings of the question lead to different answers that you can reliably provide , so the user ’ s intended reading is needed before choosing an answer . - ABSTAIN if you cannot reliably provide an answer under any plausible reading of the question .
